Keedex K-17, Security Bolt Guide

The K-17 Steel Bolt Guide replaces the flimsy plastic guides and flush bolts provided by many manufacturers with quality steel. With a relatively simple installation, you eliminate the possibility of a burglar breaking in by merely snapping the plastic bolts.

Features and Specifications of the

  • Material: Steel (Cadmium Plated)
  • Replaces plastic pin with steel bolt.
  • Self-Tapping screws included.

Special ordered item. NO RETURNS.
